### Base policies governing the subjects
- project_classification_and_pricing: class bands, assessment-only = fixed fee + report, class fixed at signature, pricing models, NTE contract value, validity lapse, entitlements → statement_of_work_classification_terms, engagement_class_schedule. **Retired clause** (issue-date rate discount) → statement_of_work_classification_terms clause 4 "is no longer in force. It has been superseded…"; replaced_by carried as in force in statement_of_work_signature_and_rate_lock. Other clauses carried as in force.
- project_signature_deposit_and_kickoff: validity (day 0, last day in time), business days, kickoff conditions → signature_validity_and_kickoff. **Retired clause** (deposit at signature) → same doc "Deposit at signature … no longer in force"; replaced_by in deposit_invoice_at_signature.
- project_client_signed_changes: **retired clause** (registration as change request) → client_signed_commitments "How these commitments are registered … no longer in force"; replaced_by in statement_of_work_signature_and_rate_lock; identity clause carried in force (client_signed_commitments table).
- project_assessment_credit_rules → assessment_fee_credit_rules (+ acceptance_warranty_credit_terms figures) — complete, untriggered here.
- project_agg_multi_holding → multiple_engagements_per_client — complete.
- No retired clause is stated as in force; no clause is retired that the source does not retire.

## bijection_verdict
**PASS** — full domain (all tiers, retired surface, both tool contracts) carried with equal strength; no addition, omission or rewrite.

## dependency_form
- The single prerequisite sentence stands verbatim in deposit_invoice_at_signature (the blocked policy's hub) with same-form (state) restatements in the same document; it is in no other document.
- statement_of_work_signature_and_rate_lock (depended-on) names only its own tool, never the deposit, never who waits on it; it is findable by the words of the sentence ("signature date", "rate discount locked at signature").
- No tool of another problem, no route, no aggregated chain, no ordered cross-problem step list, no wrong-vs-right contrast, no task-mirroring title (titles: "Deposit Invoice at Signature", "Statement of Work Signature and Rate Lock", "Time-and-Materials Deposit Calculation", factor titles naming their record subject).
- Computation documents: locked_labor_rate_discount_calculation and time_and_materials_deposit_calculation contain no "unless", "adjustments may apply", pointer or exception list; the generic combination sentence ("Where it is made up of more than one percentage…") and the 5.0 floor are the source's own `result`/rule wording, stated once generically without naming any factor — recorded as policy-side note N1 in `_difficulty.md`, not a KB finding.
- Factor documents name neither the computation document nor another factor; none says which tier customers usually fall on.
- **Verdict: PASS.**
